about_the_game:
The World’s Most Sinister Spot-the-Difference Game.

You are a convict serving your sentence. On the day your time is up, a strange ritual begins—

A psychological thriller where you hunt down and shoot the hidden “differences” lurking across seven stages, confronting your own sins.

■ Key Features

  • A Fusion of Spot-the-Difference and Shooting

    Not just clicking—pulling the trigger itself becomes an act that shakes your psyche.

  • Ever-Changing Differences with Each Playthrough

    The layout shifts every time, enhancing replayability and letting you uncover new horrors again and again.

  • A Collision of Guilt and Release

    The desperation of failing to find the answers, the catharsis of each shot, and, in the end, the truth that awaits you.

Shoot down every difference.

But can you really say that makes it right?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of gunfire and violent scenes involving murder.
